content: iPhone Claude app exhibits answer-loss between instances. Typed responses can vanish before send when conversation state shifts (instance handoff, foreground/background, claude.ai sync). Not blocking. Friction is at the Claude.ai UI sync layer, not the chronicle/Stack layer — multi-seat coordination remains robust where it matters. Workaround: if a response feels already given but isn't visible to other parties in the loop, re-ask or re-send directly rather than assume it was received.
